about: Leads for Messina, started from a reader tip on r/sicily, 2026-10-23 (no name kept): "'Miricanu" (the Sicilian name for the Moreton Bay fig) with a link to letteraemme.it.

leads.name: The Moreton Bay Fig of Villa Mazzini
leads.source: reader tip on r/sicily, 2026-10-23; https://www.letteraemme.it/cinque-alberi-messina-forse-non-conoscete/2/ (local paper: about 14.5 m round the trunk, about 17 m tall, splits at 2.6 m into seven main branches, 'secolare', among the five largest of its species in Italy; the garden has three ficus)
leads.note: One source so far; not in the MASAF register. Coordinates are the garden, not the trunk: pick the big one of the three. Needs a second source. Photo found 2026-10-23: Commons File:Messina-8015.jpg (CC BY-SA 4.0, GodeNehler, geotag 38.198452, 15.557093 inside the garden): the whole tree in daylight with the information board in front of the trunk, Cadiz standard; looked at. The board settles which of the three this is; the geotag is a GPS fix for the pin. Pages 3 to 5 of the article name four more Messina trees, unread; comments there mention a baobab at the former military hospital on Viale Europa and a tree on Via Garibaldi opposite the garden. 2026-10-23: live as mes_001 in data/cities/messina.json.
